kpis.description_fr: ASV = run-rate subscription. Métrique principale FactSet (Bloomberg / Refinitiv competitor). Recurring 90%+.
kpis.description_en: ASV = subscription run-rate. Main FactSet metric (Bloomberg / Refinitiv competitor). 90%+ recurring.

kpis.description_fr: Clients firms total (asset managers, buy-side, banques, corporates). Modèle land-and-expand : montée en gamme produit + cross-sell sur même client. Indicateur clé de pénétration marché B2B.
kpis.description_en: Total client firms (asset managers, buy-side, banks, corporates). Land-and-expand model: product upsell + cross-sell on same account. Key B2B market penetration indicator.

kpis.description_fr: Workstations actifs (utilisateurs nominaux). Per-user pricing model (vs Bloomberg per-terminal premium).
kpis.description_en: Active workstations (named users). Per-user pricing model (vs Bloomberg per-terminal premium).

kpis.description_fr: Rétention >95% firms-level. Indicateur de stickiness produit : intégration profonde dans workflows quotidiens (modèles, recherche, terminaux). Inversion difficile pour concurrents Bloomberg / Refinitiv.
kpis.description_en: Retention >95% firms-level. Product stickiness indicator: deep integration in daily workflows (models, research, terminals). Hard to displace vs Bloomberg / Refinitiv competitors.

kpis_story.description_fr: FactSet Mercury (LLM copilot pour workflows). Premier release 2024. Premium monetization premium tier ($1500-2000+/user/an).
kpis_story.description_en: FactSet Mercury (LLM copilot for workflows). First 2024 release. Premium tier monetization ($1500-2000+/user/year).

kpis_story.description_en: Idaciti 2024 acquisition (XBRL data). Private markets data expansion (PitchBook competitor). Growth alpha pivot vs mature public markets.
